title: From skidding to rolling
caption: Friction slows the ball (v falls at μg = 0.98 m s⁻²) and spins it up (ωR rises at 5μg/2 = 2.45 m s⁻²). They meet at t = 2.33 s, when v = ωR = 5.71 m s⁻¹ (5/7 of the launch speed) and the ball rolls without slipping.
alt: Two lines against time: speed falling from 8 and rim speed omega R rising from zero, meeting at 2.33 seconds and 5.71 metres per second.
description: Rim speed: ωR = 2.45t, since α = μmgR / (⅖mR²) = 5μg / 2R.
They are equal at t = 8 / (0.98 + 2.45) = 2.33 s, where v = 5.71 m s⁻¹ = 5/7 × 8.
After that there is no slipping and kinetic friction stops acting.

checks.name: the rolling speed is 5/7 of the launch speed
